title: MathOS Millennium proof-obligation register
scope: Research work packages from mathos.proof_analysis.gap_analysis.models(), not complete definitions or verified sufficient mathematical proof routes.

external_result.statement: Poincare conjecture via established Perelman proof
external_result.source_locator: Official Clay Mathematics Institute Poincare problem materials; precise theorem-level citation still needs reviewer entry.
external_result.note: This is not a MathOS proof. The distinct target POINCARE.reconstruction is open.

abstract_algorithm.statement: For every valid finite acyclic AND/OR graph and target, the recurrence returns all and only the inclusion-minimal open-leaf completion sets under its authored Boolean semantics.
abstract_algorithm.boundary: This does not prove the mathematical sufficiency of authored routes or certify the Python implementation.

sat_subresult.statement: For m >= 0, the polynomial over Z in 2m distinct variables given by product_i(x_i+y_i-x_i*y_i) has exactly 3^m nonzero monomials.
sat_subresult.boundary: Explicit expansion lower bound only; not a general SAT algorithm lower bound.
